enemy-046-colonial-raider.designLock: Colonial Raider is an original Tantalus frontier/scavenger combat archetype, not a published Alien faction or exact external uniform. Lock one unnamed ordinary adult human ambusher with visible eyes above a fixed half-face dust respirator, dusty gray short hooded utility coat, sand canvas chest harness, one scratched brown composite shoulder plate on the near shoulder only, charcoal work trousers, battered dark boots, fingered gloves, compact filter-and-salvage pack, muted ochre identification tape without lettering, and exactly one original compact semi-automatic scavenger carbine with a straight detachable magazine. The silhouette is mobile, asymmetrical and practical: layered colonial workwear repaired from local materials, never a Space Marine, cowboy, spiked wasteland raider or branded USCMC/UPP/Weyland-Yutani soldier. Palette stays sand, dusty gray, brown synthetic leather, scratched dull metal, charcoal and one restrained ochre accent. Strict right-facing orthographic gameplay profile with one coherent carbine across all five clips. Future pixels must be entirely original fan-made project art; licensed sources establish only the broad Alien frontier, scarcity and criminal-colony context and may never be traced, copied or presented as an official Colonial Raider design.

topology.rule: Both hands remain anatomically connected and operate the same single carbine. Hood, respirator, asymmetric shoulder plate, chest harness, compact pack and all limbs remain attached through every pose.

referenceLock.silhouette: Lean ordinary adult human in short layered frontier workwear: raised hood, half-face respirator, one near-side shoulder plate, crossed canvas harness, compact salvage pack and one compact carbine. Asymmetry signals improvised repair without spikes or fantasy armor.
referenceLock.armorAndPalette: Dusty gray short utility coat, sand canvas harness, one scratched brown composite shoulder plate, charcoal trousers, dark battered boots/gloves, dull steel hardware and a small muted ochre blank tape accent. No faction logo or readable text.
referenceLock.faceAndRespirator: One new non-celebrity face. Eyes and brow remain visible beneath the hood; a fixed gray-brown half-mask with two small practical filters covers nose and mouth. No skull mask, gas-mask lenses, cybernetic eye or sealed helmet.

weapon.lockedModel: Original compact semi-automatic frontier scavenger carbine
weapon.finish: scratched charcoal steel with muted brown composite furniture and one straight detachable box magazine
weapon.requiredRead: One coherent short stock, receiver, handguard, simple iron sights, narrow barrel and straight magazine; practical and repairable rather than futuristic military issue.
weapon.reloadLogic: Remove one straight box magazine, insert one matching replacement, operate one stable action and return to the same ready silhouette.

referenceLock.facing: Strict right-facing orthographic gameplay side view in all 40 future poses; carbine muzzle points right and never toward camera.

scale.gameplayRole: Mobile lightly protected human ambush unit in npc-standing gameplay class.
scale.rigidLandmark: Measure hood crown-to-boot standing height and fixed butt-to-muzzle carbine length in comparable ready poses.
scale.forbiddenMetric: Do not scale from coat tails, respirator straps, muzzle flash, recoil reach, loose magazine, backpack tools, corpse width or total pose bounding box.

rootAndGround.pivotStatus: queue precedent only; requires pose-by-pose physical-foot review after generation
rootAndGround.bodyRoot: Project pelvis mass to the support plane; the carbine, coat tails and backpack never define the anchor.
rootAndGround.livePoses: At least one boot carries credible load; keep a low ambush posture without skating, tiptoe hover or per-frame scale drift.
rootAndGround.death: Terminal root lies below the collapsed pelvis/torso, not below the carbine muzzle or dropped magazine.

sourceContract.background: true transparent RGBA or perfectly uniform opaque #FF00FF
sourceContract.cellIsolation: Exactly one complete raider and the complete single carbine per cell; no limb, muzzle, magazine, coat tail, strap or tool crosses a cell boundary.
sourceContract.identityScale: One face, hood, respirator, outfit, shoulder plate, pack, carbine and scale across idle, move, attack, death and reload.

move.rule: Quiet predatory advance with compact steps and carbine controlled in both hands; no cowboy run, military parade gait or cell translation.

attack.rule: One controlled semi-automatic shot. Any tiny attached muzzle flash remains subordinate and never changes anatomy, scale or cell isolation.

death.rule: Irreversible human collapse. Carbine may settle beside the body but may not vanish, multiply, float or become the body anchor.

reload.rule: One readable weapon-specific reload with at most one loose magazine visible; no carbine redesign between frames.

prohibitions: No claim that Colonial Raider is an official Alien faction, licensed uniform, canonical organization or exact external character model.

No cybernetic limbs, ATARAX suit, sealed astronaut helmet, full gas-mask lenses, glowing tech, neon cyberpunk panels or oversized shoulder armor.
No real-world rifle copy, energy weapon, scope stack, suppressor, launcher, bayonet, second firearm or weapon morphing.
No giant readable text, invented logo, scenery, floor, cast shadow, UI, watermark, left-facing/frontal/three-quarter pose, crop, cell contact or copied official/licensed bitmap.
